title: Internal: Ordering a Debit Card for a Bank Account
summary: Explains how to order a debit card for a specific OPEN checking account (personal or business), including eligibility rules (verified customer, account_type='checking', open ≥3 business days, ≥$25 balance, age ≥18, ≤1 active debit card, no PENDING order, valid US domestic address). Covers STANDARD (free, 7–10 business days), EXPEDITED ($15, 3–5 business days), RUSH ($35, 1–2 business days) delivery, and design options CLASSIC (default), PREMIUM ($10 one-time), CUSTOM ($25 one-time, subject to approval), plus steps and the order procedure using order_debit_card_5739.
faqs: Can I order a debit card for my savings account or only checking accounts?
What requirements must my checking account meet to be eligible for a debit card?
How long does each delivery option take (STANDARD/EXPEDITED/RUSH) and what are the fees?
What are the one-time fees and restrictions for PREMIUM and CUSTOM card designs?
Will the delivery/design fees be deducted from my checking account, and what happens if there aren’t enough funds?
How do activation, existing card behavior, and shipment tracking work after ordering?
keywords: open for at least 3 business days
no more than 1 active debit card
valid US domestic address (no international shipping)
